label: Relation-of-reason account: an invariant intrinsic act whose terminus, not the bearer, varies
term: relation-of-reason (extrinsic-decree) account of a contingent effect
definition: RelationOfReasonAt p Has w a x: on the #462 OutputProfile p with world-indexed real determinations Has (DEF 3aba5f19), (1) the source's real determinations are the same at every world accessible from w (IntrinsicProfileInvariant); (2) some real determination of the source carries the act a: the source has it at w and performs a wherever it has it (ActCarriedBy); (3) the act's terminus at w is x (p.output w a x); (4) every terminus of a at an accessible world exists there (TerminusSound); (5) x is contingent at w (CONTINGENT_1). The terminus relation p.output is not a real determination of the source: nothing in the definition puts it in Has, and the certificate proves that no fact intrinsic to the source tracks it.
note: Stipulated for #2145 lane M. It formalizes the account onto which #2174 (premise lane E, N 906f9077, Lean-only classicalSelectionControl) and lane P (parAlternativeExcludedAtRoot, on branch research/premise-purity) push the classical root: its free willing adds no real intrinsic determination; what differs between worlds is the terminus. Navigation only, attribution deferred: the scholastic thesis that the relation of creator to creature is real in the creature and of reason in God (compare DEF 46b1ef72 on divine lordship, ST I q.13 a.7, which is sourced only for lordship). Nothing in the definition mentions intellect or will: an impersonal permissive propensity whose chance outcome is its terminus satisfies the same clauses, so any price proved from it falls on both readings alike at the level of the formal account. Lane P records an extra descriptive commitment of the personal side: only it calls its invariant act 'willing x'. Open obligations: (1) no positive warrant is recorded for 'wills x' being true of a bearer with no real determination answering to x; the objection that content-specific conative states are intrinsic is this lane's reconstruction, and its inductive base (finite agents) is of the same kind as the base from which the personal case transfers will to the root, so the reference-class test cuts both ways and the asymmetry stays open. (2) TerminusSound gives only output → existence at accessible worlds; if in addition the terminus is constituted by the effect's existence (output ↔ existence at accessible worlds), the terminus is coextensive with the effect there, and the account cannot claim contrastive explanation of the effect by the terminus without explaining it by a fact it constitutes. The certificate proves only that no intrinsic fact discriminates; other extrinsic facts are not ranged over.
